headline: France blames Iran for major cyber-attack on food freezers
standfirst: Paris is pushing for European sanctions following a massive hack on supermarket cooling

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: France says Iran launched a massive cyber-attack against supermarket freezers and chillers last month.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The French foreign minister described the operation as an attack of unprecedented scale.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Targeting essential food infrastructure is a major escalation that threatens daily supply chains.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: France is now pushing for the European Union to impose new sanctions against Tehran.

caption:
France has officially linked Iran to a cyber-attack that targeted supermarket freezers.

The French government claims this incident was unprecedented in scale. Officials are now calling for a coordinated European response to hold Tehran accountable for the disruption.

Should cyber-attacks on food supply infrastructure be treated as acts of war?
